corroborator.mode: YOLO.predict independentlyperframe, no tracker, no temporalstate or windowresets. Cacheall1530frames beforelabels/scoring; integertruncatebounds likeapp. Geometryveto only; no identityfeatures or annotationinput.
corroborator.preprocessing: Ultralytics8.4.80 YOLO.predict receives sourceBGRuint8 arrays; its standard letterbox/normalization and resolvedimgsz/rect/batch/quantize/conf/iou/max_det are recorded. FP16MPS matches priorcorroboration cache; CPUFP32appliesonlyinitialSAM.

scope: Single-process app-runtime verification of the selected exposed-development candidate. No reserved footage or truth is loaded by inference.

naming.pairing: reciprocal-best same-frame IoU; no coordinate averaging

execution: One MPS thread reads each verified frame once. CutieFP32 every0.5s; rawYOLOFP16 plus original-mask quarantine, LCC geometry, p10 and reciprocal naming at1Hz. Parent approval required before GPU launch.
output_contract: Each1Hz row retains all visible LCC boxes and original zero-based track IDs. named_track_ids includes only original named seeds1-6. Class confidence is actual paired YOLO score or null, never fabricated1.0. Original indexed masks, raw-assigned-pixel probabilities and frame hashes permit independent replay.
timing: Per-input stage timings include decode/hash, synchronized models, decision/mask cache and Metal reclamation. Overall elapsed additionally includes initialization and report writes. Existing1s sustained-processing stop is a safety cap;2fps throughput requires mean<=0.5s/input and is reported separately.
memory: SDK defaults bound working and long-term memory. Quarantine keeps30past indexed masks plus active anchors. No source RGB frames are retained. Post-reclaimMetaldriver and peakRSS each capped8GiB.
limitations: Original reviewed seeds only; no automatic enrollment, new arrivals, reentry or reconnect names.
Geometry-based recovery is not independent identity proof.
All three panels are exposed development, not blind evaluation.
No labels at intermediate half seconds; prior corroboration is never treated as fresh evidence.
prelaunch_correction: Accept equivalent torch.device Metal spellings mps and mps:0; reject CPU. Corrected before any joint GPU inference; candidate decisions unchanged.
